top_signals.title: Guidance: Managing public money
top_signals.summary: This publication offers guidance on how to handle public funds.

top_signals.title: Trump, CFTC Chair Selig expected at Wednesday White House meeting with crypto and prediction market executives
top_signals.summary: The session is scheduled for 2:30 p.m. ET on Wednesday and is intended as a kickoff for the CFTC's first Innovation Advisory Committee meeting the next day.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Inside the Business of Ultra Luxury Travel
top_signals.summary: Luxury Travel and Event Expert Olivia Ferney sits down with Lisa Mateo, Joe Mathieu and Carol Massar on Bloomberg This Weekend and shares how she has built a business catering to ultrawealthy clients whose requests can range from six-figure vacations to elaborate celebrations, while creating a social media following of more than 1 million. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: CENTCOM launches multinational attack drone task force
top_signals.summary: Task Force Falcon Strike will employ one-way attack drones composed of unmanned systems from above, on and below the sea.

top_signals.title: OCC grants conditional approval for Trump-backed World Liberty National Trust bank
top_signals.summary: President Donald Trump-backed World Liberty Financial secured preliminary approval to become a national trust bank on Friday.
